What I did:
- I removed the room and floor and put the shoe on plain studio white, with a soft shadow under the sole and no text.
- I told the editor to keep the whole sneaker and its side view exactly as they are: the same shape, laces, stitching, heel tab and sole, with nothing cropped.
- The image is wide (16:9), close to your original's shape. On your free plan it comes out at up to 640px wide, the same size as your photo.

About your worry: this is an AI edit, so it redraws the image rather than cutting the shoe out. Please compare it with your photo, especially the lace loops, the stitching lines and the sole edge. I couldn't preview the result here, so I can't promise every detail matches.

If anything looks different, tell me what. I can run it again (5 credits), or I can use the background remover. The remover cuts out your actual shoe pixel for pixel and puts it on white, so the shoe can't change. It wouldn't add a shadow, though.
